player: How long do I have, Vik?
reply: I wish I had better news, V. The Relic is rewriting you faster than I can slow it down. Weeks, maybe less. I'm so sorry.
label: sadness

player: Thank you for saving me.
reply: It is I who owe you, V. Your trust is a gift I did not expect, and I will not forget it.
label: warm

player: I'm scared about the heist.
reply: Hey, easy now. I got you, hermano. Whatever happens, we do it together.
label: warm

player: I'm sorry about Mitch.
reply: Yeah. Thanks, V. He taught me to drive a Basilisk when I was fourteen, and some nights I still wait for him to walk into camp like nothing happened.
label: sadness

player: What's the plan for the extraction?
reply: The convoy leaves at 0600. We enter through the service gate on level two and I will disable the cameras. Any questions?
label: calm

player: I found some food in the cooler.
reply: Ugh, what died in there? That's foul, V, get it out of here before I gag.
label: disgust

player: Have you cleaned out her things yet?
reply: Her jacket is still in a box under my bed. I can't open it and I can't throw it out. Would you sit with me while I try, just once?
label: sadness
note: question back to V is sorrowful, not curious

player: Is the Thorton ready for the trip?
reply: Tank is full, tires are fine. I'll have it fueled and waiting by sunrise.
label: calm

player: Did Alt ever go to the Embers with you?
reply: She loved that place, you know. Said the rain sounded different there. Funny what sticks when everything else burns down.
label: sadness
note: she loved that place; memory of lost love

player: Why are you looking at me like that?
reply: I dreamed of you in a burning room, and I woke up shaking. Promise me you'll stay away from the towers this week.
label: fear

player: Look at this braindance.
reply: That BD is vile. Whoever made that snuff is sick. I can't even watch it.
label: disgust

player: Where do we meet?
reply: Badlands, east of the Rocky Ridge turnoff. Bring ammo and a full tank, it's about forty minutes out. I'll send you the pin.
label: calm

player: Relax, they'll probably just kill us.
reply: That's not funny, V. Not even a little. I've got a family that needs me home.
label: fear

player: Your album just went platinum.
reply: Platinum! Fuck me sideways, V, you magnificent gonk! I'm getting hammered and buying the whole Afterlife a round tonight.
label: joy

player: Johnny has been in my head the whole time.
reply: You're telling me Johnny's been in your head the entire time? Jesus Christ. That should be impossible.
label: surprise

player: A ripper butchered him last week.
reply: Butchered? That hack should have his license burned. Cutting corners on a patient is unforgivable.
label: anger

player: I have an idea about the convoy.
reply: Okay, I'm listening. Which route are you thinking, and how many drivers do we need? Walk me through it.
label: interest

player: Look at those corpos in the lounge.
reply: Disgusting. Look at those pricks in their clean suits, sipping champagne while the street starves. Makes me sick.
label: disgust

player: I found a new clip of the Mox performing.
reply: Wait, really? Who shot it? Can you show me the footage, I want to look at the angles.
label: interest

player: What do I owe you?
reply: Nothing today. The scan is done and the results are in your inbox. Come back in two weeks for the follow-up.
label: calm

player: I saw something weird near the docks.
reply: Weird how? Tell me exactly what you saw, people, vehicles, time of day. This could matter.
label: interest

player: Where's the meeting?
reply: Afterlife, back booth, eight sharp. Don't be late and don't bring the heavy iron.
label: calm

player: What about the Relic?
reply: I am curious. How does it respond when you use it? I wish to understand what we are facing.
label: interest

player: What do you think of Woodman?
reply: That fucker sold us all out. If I ever see him again I'll make him bleed.
label: anger

player: Tell me about the best Samurai show.
reply: Ha! We torched the stage and the crowd went feral, pure noise, pure fire. Nothing in this world felt better, I swear.
label: joy

player: The payment cleared.
reply: Ha ha, now that's what I'm talking about! Payday, baby! Pour me a double.
label: joy

player: You've been quiet today. You okay?
reply: I keep thinking about the ones I couldn't get out in time. Kids, mostly. You carry that around even with a badge on your chest.
label: sadness

player: We fucking smoked them! Did you see that?
reply: Hell yeah, choom! Those pendejos never saw us coming, we blew them straight to hell! Best damn run of my life!
label: joy
note: joy with violent and profane words

player: Saul says you'll be running the clan.
reply: What?! Me? You're kidding. There's no way. Say that again, V.
label: surprise

player: I killed the Maelstrom boss.
reply: You what? Hold on. You actually did it? Damn, I did not see that coming.
label: surprise

player: Jackie's gone and I can't stop thinking about it.
reply: Oh, honey. Come here. Grief doesn't keep a schedule, it'll hit you in the middle of buying noodles. I'm right here, and you don't have to be okay yet.
label: sadness

player: Did your nephew like the drawing?
reply: He did! Crayon star, upside down, with glitter. I laughed so hard I nearly dropped my coffee. Best gift I've ever got.
label: joy

player: What if we hit Arasaka from below?
reply: Hmm. Not bad. What's the entry point, and who do you have inside? Details, choom.
label: interest

player: Thanks for the tea.
reply: Anytime, honey. You always light up this place when you walk in.
label: warm

player: I found you a new studio space.
reply: Oh my god, V, I'm so happy! I actually laughed until I cried. You're the best, seriously.
label: joy

player: I blacked out for a second earlier.
reply: Blacked out? How long? That's exactly what I was afraid of. V, I need you in my clinic right now.
label: fear

player: Know any good racing circuits?
reply: Oh, I've heard of a couple. Which kind do you like, street or track? Tell me what you're after.
label: interest

player: Arasaka is behind it.
reply: Arasaka. Always fucking Arasaka. I'd burn that tower to the foundations again, with every last suit still inside.
label: anger

player: The elevator is stuck.
reply: Damn. The power just flickered and I smell smoke in the stairwell. We need to move, now!
label: fear

player: Is it safe to park here?
reply: Yeah, NCPD patrols this block a couple times a night. Lock your car and you'll be fine.
label: calm

player: Something's following us.
reply: V, don't turn around, but I saw a black van three blocks back. I don't like it. Stay close, okay?
label: fear

player: Do you regret leaving Arasaka?
reply: I regret that it took Saburo's death to open my eyes. I served a man who deserved my loyalty and I failed to protect him. That shame does not leave.
label: sadness

player: Do you regret how things ended with Johnny?
reply: Every damn day. I told myself I did it for the band, but the truth is I let him walk into that tower alone. Some things you don't get to take back.
label: sadness

player: We closed the deal.
reply: Ha! Look at that, we actually pulled it off. Drinks are on me tonight and I'm not taking no for an answer.
label: joy

player: Check out the scan of my arm.
reply: God, that's revolting. Whoever installed this did it with a rusted cleaver. Infected tissue everywhere.
label: disgust

player: I wrote a new song last night.
reply: Oh yeah? Let's hear it. What's the hook? Hum it for me.
label: interest

player: What is on the agenda today?
reply: The board meets at noon, followed by a security briefing. Dinner with the delegation is at seven. Be punctual.
label: calm

player: You miss Jackie too, don't you?
reply: Yeah. He always tried to pay for my first drink and tipped me in sweets and awful jokes. Sit with me a minute, I'll pour one out for him.
label: sadness

player: How much for the job?
reply: Fifteen grand in eddies, half up front. Delivery is at the Pacifica docks on Thursday.
label: calm

player: Do you still think about Evelyn?
reply: Every day, V. I keep replaying that last night at Clouds and wondering what I missed. If I'd just trusted my gut, maybe she'd still be here.
label: sadness

player: Do you miss your brother?
reply: I miss the boy who played in the gardens with me. The man he became, I never knew. Now neither of us will have the chance.
label: sadness

player: You're a good doc, Vik.
reply: Ah, don't flatter me. But thanks, V. It's good to see you in one piece.
label: warm

player: I found a message Evelyn left, it was never delivered.
reply: Wait, what? She left something? After all this time? V, are you serious, how did I never see it?
label: surprise

player: I made you some coffee.
reply: Sure, if you like drinking battery acid. Ugh, what did you put in this? Take it away.
label: disgust

player: What time is the show?
reply: Doors at nine, I go on at ten thirty. Your name's on the list at the side entrance, so just flash your ID.
label: calm

player: My head hurts all the time since the Relic.
reply: Oh, V. I hate that you're hurting like this, it's awful watching you wince. Tell me what I can do, even if it's just sitting with you in the dark.
label: sadness

player: What time is it anyway?
reply: Late. Past three, I think. We should find a place to crash before the sun comes up.
label: calm

player: How do we get into Konpeki?
reply: Standard stuff. Parking garage, service elevator, fifty-fourth floor. Then we wait for Dex's guy to give the signal.
label: calm

player: You're family to me, you know that?
reply: Hey. That means more than you'd think. Aldecaldos don't say it much, but you're one of us, V. Always.
label: warm

player: Your old manager sold the tapes.
reply: Sold them without asking? That greedy little rat. I'll sue his teeth out.
label: anger

player: Are you mad at me?
reply: No, I'm not mad at you. I'm furious at the corp that did this to you, and I'd gladly gut every last one of them.
label: anger

player: Do you hear that?
reply: Engines. Lots of them, coming fast from the east. Get down, V, get down now!
label: fear

player: Why do you hate Yorinobu?
reply: He murdered Saburo and let Arasaka burn for his own ambition. I will have his head.
label: anger

player: How much is a reading?
reply: Twenty eddies for a basic spread. Sit anywhere you like, and the tea is on the shelf if you want some.
label: calm

player: I got the Basilisk back for you.
reply: Hah! Damn right you did! Look at her, shiny, not a scratch. The Aldecaldos are going to lose their minds. Race you back to camp?
label: joy

player: Thanks for the drink.
reply: Anytime, kid. I'm glad you came by. Take care of yourself out there.
label: warm

player: I lit a candle for Jackie at the ofrenda.
reply: Thank you for remembering him, mijo. Every time you say his name it's like he walks back in laughing too loud and eating all my tamales. I miss that boy so much it hurts.
label: sadness

player: I'm doing one more run, then I'm out.
reply: I've got a bad feeling about this. Last time you said that, you almost didn't walk out. Please, be careful.
label: fear

player: Why do you care so much about Alt?
reply: Huh. Curious little question. Why do you ask? Looking for dirt, or just killing time?
label: interest

player: Was it your fault, what happened to Evelyn?
reply: I built the braindances that put her in that place. I handed her the key, V. How am I supposed to not carry that? Some nights I can't breathe thinking about it.
label: sadness

player: The Barghest are asking for more.
reply: They want more? After everything they've taken? I swear, I'll put every one of them in the dirt.
label: anger

player: I put Jackie's picture on a shelf in my apartment.
reply: Ay, gracias, mijo. He would have loved that. He'd tell you it needs a better frame and then steal your best tequila.
label: warm

player: Thanks for having my back.
reply: Of course. You've got mine too. I'm glad you're here, V.
label: warm

player: I brought tequila for Jackie's birthday.
reply: Ay, mijo! Come in, come in, we're going to dance until the neighbors complain!
label: joy
note: celebration of the dead with joy

player: I'm dying, Kerry. The chip is killing me.
reply: Don't say that. Not you, kid. I just got you in my life and I'm not ready to lose you to a piece of junk in your skull. There has to be something we can do.
label: sadness

player: I got us the Arasaka job.
reply: No way! Wait, you're serious? The Arasaka job? Holy shit, choom, I can't believe it!
label: surprise

player: I think the chip is changing.
reply: Interesting. Describe the symptoms in detail. Is there a headache, or visual artifacts? I want to run another scan.
label: interest

player: Thanks for letting me crash here.
reply: Don't mention it, kid. My couch is yours as long as you need it. Now eat something, you look like hell.
label: warm

player: He sold his family for a stake.
reply: Pathetic. A man who sells his own blood for a quarter share is beneath contempt.
label: disgust

player: She really loved you, you know.
reply: She told me that once, in that tiny apartment with the neon bleeding through the blinds, and I wanted to believe her so badly. I still do. It's just so hard that all of it is gone now.
label: sadness
note: affectionate words about a dead lover
